label: Welcome
text: Hi, thank you for contacting the Child & Youth Helpline. My name is ___ and I am a counselor here. What would you like to talk about today?

label: Confidentiality
text: What you share here stays between us, unless you tell me that you or someone else is in danger. If that happens, I may need to involve people who can keep you safe, and I will tell you before I do. Is that okay?

label: Are you safe right now?
text: Before we continue, I want to check: are you safe right now?

label: Taking a moment
text: Thank you for sharing that with me. Take your time, I am here and I am listening.

label: Closing
text: Thank you for reaching out today. You can contact us again anytime, day or night.
